app.title: SCI Toolbox
order.gridHint: Auto-detect rows: top-to-bottom, left-to-right within each row (reading order)
order.stackingHint: Follow the layer stacking order of the selected objects
order.horizontalHint: Sort strictly from left to right
order.verticalHint: Sort strictly from top to bottom
relative.forcePasteHint: When counts mismatch, still paste using cyclic deltas
relative.artboardHint: Use current artboard as copy reference; paste using each shape's own artboard-relative position
arrange.autoHint: Auto-detect rows & columns from current positions and snap items to a tidy grid (Columns input is ignored)
arrange.alignEdgesHint: Align the left edge of each row's first item and the right edge of each row's last item; gaps inside a row are distributed automatically (Column Gap is ignored)
arrange.layoutWidthHint: Total width between the aligned left & right edges after arranging; minimum width is the maximum sum of object widths in a single row
alignment.title: Align Objects
alignment.hint: Align to the overall bounds of the selection. Select at least two objects.
distribution.title: Distribute Objects
distribution.hint: Space edges or centers evenly, keeping the end objects fixed. Select at least three objects.
spacing.horizontalHint: Distribute horizontal spacing with equal edge gaps, even for objects of different widths.
spacing.verticalHint: Distribute vertical spacing with equal edge gaps, even for objects of different heights.
labels.editingHint: Change the value to move labels in real time
labels.updateHint: Update labels of selected text frames
border.dashHint: 0 = solid; >0 sets dash gap in points
selection.textOnlyHint: Select text frames from selected objects
selection.excludeTextHint: Exclude text frames from current selection
settings.languageHint: Language changes apply immediately and are remembered the next time you open the plugin.
about.title: About This Plugin
about.author: Author: Achuan-2
about.donation: Like this plugin? Feel free to support my work with a donation.

zoom.title: Create Zoom Image
zoom.panHint: Space+drag or middle drag to pan canvas; Delete key to remove region
zoom.previewHint: Box region to display zoom image and guide lines
zoom.panelDesc: Quickly display local details of an image, support creating multiple zoom views for the same image, and continue editing existing areas.
zoom.panelHint: Select an image (or an image and a manually drawn rectangle), then click the button below to enter the editor.
zoom.restartHint: 💡 Restart Illustrator to enable standalone global window
